descriptions.zh-Hans: 我做的纸菜单里，夹饼已经放下，两只小手还弯着。
descriptions.en: My handmade menu shows the taco down and its two hands still curved.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使自制的纸菜单记着两边收好的袖口，不标店名或商标。
descriptions.en: My own paper menu records two neatly rolled cuffs without a shop name or trademark.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我在离馆后用两道弧线记下摆动，没有描摹展厅或复制展品。
descriptions.en: Two arcs I drew after leaving recall the swing without reproducing the exhibit.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我把纸签两边折向不同方向，记着转过身听水的片刻。
descriptions.en: I folded the sides of my tab in opposite directions for a turn spent listening to water.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使自己折的小帽檐卡，下方两道短弧是还在移动的眼睛。
descriptions.en: My folded paper brim sits above two little arcs for eyes that kept moving.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我把纸压成鼓鼓的圆角，记着孩子把小球抱进外套的样子。
descriptions.en: A rounded paper corner I shaped recalls the ball bulging beneath a child’s coat.
